name: Violet Powder
summary: Sprinkle sends Violet Powder to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan, asking him to repay a favor. Marin is willing to try it.

sections.title: A Favor for Sprinkle
sections.body: In Gadgetzan, Marin Noggenfogger receives Violet Powder from Sprinkle. Sprinkle asks you to deliver it and tell Marin that he owes a favor. Marin accepts the powder and says it could hardly make things worse.

faq.answer: Sprinkle sends Violet Powder to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan, who agrees to try it.

faq.q: Who gives you the Violet Powder?
faq.answer: Sprinkle gives you Violet Powder and asks you to take it to Marin Noggenfogger.

faq.q: Who is supposed to get the powder?
faq.answer: Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan is the one meant to receive Violet Powder.

faq.q: Why does Sprinkle say Marin owes her?
faq.answer: Sprinkle asks you to tell Marin that he owes her a favor; no further details are given.
